cuisineEvidence: Page identifies Thue as a Tibetan sweet; family recipe attributed to Chodrak from Lhasa.
ingredientFacts: 1 lb dri (yak) hard dried shredded cheese; Parmesan, Romano or another hard cheese suggested as alternatives
2 cups brown sugar; cane sugar or piloncillo mentioned as alternatives
6 sticks (24 oz) unsalted sweet cream butter
methodFacts: Mix cheese, sugar and butter by hand, breaking up lumps.
A wooden frame can be used for shaping, or shape by hand.
Butter decorations can be formed with ice water to keep butter cool.
